description:
Midline Silver Skins

MSS was made to give the player a Midline fleet that was visually distinct (on the most basic level) from vessels fielded by vanilla factions. I've included white-gray skins for all combat Midline ships, fighters, and stations. The new skins are featured in the Midline blueprints, so you will see other factions using some of these ships. The larger and rarer hulls will need to have their blueprints found. The new station sprites in this mod will allow players to construct aesthetically matching Midline orbital stations, battlestations, and star fortresses; these stations can be built from the get-go and do not require any blueprints. Appropriate codex entries have been made for the sake of completeness. This is ultimately a visual mod, all ships and stations are identical to their vanilla counterparts in every respect besides the sprites used.

Previews

Changelog

V1.0.1 Release Notes
This update fixes the botched initial release, meaning you can actually field Midline Silver ships without having to create variants yourself. This also means the previous claim of other factions being able to use these ships is now correct. All variants were taken from vanilla.
removed ship_data.csv mentions for Midline Silver fighters, as this was pointless while using ship skin files
updated skin files to include correct descriptions and prefixes for Midline Silver ships
added vanilla variants for all Midline Silver warships, meaning factions can actually use them now

Guidance: The fine people at Corvus Freeport for pointing me in the right direction on modding StarSector, and going off-topic at every possible chance.
